- Which classes are listed? The website lists Classes 1–10. Families should contact the school to confirm current class availability.
- Where is the academy? New Lepa, Kasrawad, Khargone district, Madhya Pradesh 451228, as published on the website.

- What are the current fees, syllabus, facilities and board/recognition details? These should be confirmed with the school office or current official documents; this file does not make an affiliation or facility claim.

## Accuracy guidance
Admission availability, fees, age rules, curriculum, school timings, facilities, events, holidays and examination dates may change. Use current school-published notices or ask the school office. Do not infer affiliation, recognition, rankings, staffing figures, enrolment, infrastructure or results from third-party listings. Similar-name schools in Kasrawad are separate institutions unless the academy confirms otherwise.

The school gallery should contain academy-approved photographs. Illustrative design images are not proof of campus facilities or actual school activities.
